what.title: What is Artisan-Compétent?

faq.title: Skilled craftsman : how does it work ?

q1.title: How to find a competent craftsman on Artisan-Compétent?
q1.p1: Finding a service provider on Artisan-Compétent is simple, fast and fully digital.
q1.intro: After signing up, you just need to:

steps.item1: choose the trade you need (plumbing, electricity, masonry...)
steps.item3: explain your need via a short video, photos or text

q1.p2: Your request is sent to qualified professionals and/or competent individuals matching your criteria. You receive several proposals to compare and choose transparently.

items.escrow1: Escrow payment: the entire quote up to €5,000 is held.
items.escrow2: Above €5,000, only labor is held (except manufacturer artisans, case by case).
items.tracking: Digital worksite tracking: photos, comments and steps in real time.
items.cmod: CMOD: an independent professional advises and intervenes in case of doubt or dispute.
items.abuse: Protection against abuses: possible intervention (within 12 to 48 hours) in case of a night-time (emergency) signed and paid quote that is clearly excessive (even after the digital report is validated within a maximum of 48 hours, please report from your dashboard).
items.pv: Digital report: no payment released without formal validation.

q3.title: What if I paid but the craftsman did not intervene?

items.escrow: Funds are held in escrow: the provider cannot be paid.
items.report: You can immediately report via your dashboard.
items.review: CMOD and admins review the case.
items.refund: Full refund if no intervention occurred within the timeframe stated in the quote; Artisan‑Compétent covers the escrow fees for you!

q4.title: Why use Artisan-Compétent only for small jobs and emergencies?

items.neutral: Neutral contact in case of issue (CMOD + platform).

q4.p: Artisan-Compétent turns a stressful situation into a secure, controlled process.

q5.title: What VAT rate applies in France for renovation works?

items.rate55: 5.5%: energy efficiency improvements (insulation, heat pumps, etc.).

q5.note: Reduced rates apply to dwellings built over 2 years ago and may cover labor and supplies if provided by the professional.
q5.advice: It's often better to let the professional supply and install; self-purchased materials are at 20%.

q6.title: What are the guidelines/obligations for providers?

items.goals: Artisan-Compétent reduces prospecting, eliminates unpaid invoices, secures payments and professionalizes client relations.
items.cmodShare: Of these 20%, 5% goes to the CMOD.

q7.title: What are the guidelines/obligations for clients?
q7.intro: To secure payments, protect all parties and avoid disputes, each client using the Artisan‑Compétent platform commits to a clear and transparent operating framework.

pay.title: Regarding payment and supplies
pay.upTo5000: For interventions whose total amount is less than or equal to €5,000, the full quote amount (labor and supplies) can be held in escrow on the platform until the final acceptance report is validated.
pay.laborOnly: However, to better fit real-world constraints, you may also choose, up to €5,000, to escrow only the labor portion on the platform.
pay.laborOnlyWhy: This option can be useful when the craftsman cannot advance materials (for example, when suppliers do not grant payment terms). It can also help limit escrow-related fees, which may be passed on to the craftsman from certain amounts.
pay.optionsIntro: In that case, several options are possible:

options.li1: you can go with the craftsman to the supplier and pay the materials directly,
options.li2: the craftsman can also go alone, advance the cost of supplies, then be reimbursed by you once the materials are delivered and on site.

pay.advanceNote: In this setup, reimbursement for supplies advanced by the craftsman may occur as soon as they are delivered, without waiting for the final acceptance report. Escrow then remains limited to the labor portion, which is released once the work is validated.
pay.above5000: For projects above €5,000, only labor is held in escrow on the platform, for the same reasons mentioned above.
pay.directSupplier: Supplies must be paid directly to the supplier, ideally with the craftsman present.
pay.discourageDirectArtisan: Paying materials directly to the craftsman is strongly discouraged, except in clearly framed and justified exceptional situations.

obl.title: Your obligations as a client

items.req: submit a clear, precise and honest request regarding your work,
items.insurance: verify the craftsman's professional insurance (professional liability and/or 10‑year warranty) by contacting the insurer directly to confirm coverage for the work to be carried out,
items.tracking: track work progress, ideally on site and, if needed, via your dedicated dashboard,
items.report: report any problem, doubt or disagreement immediately (contact CMOD only in case of dispute or concrete suspicion of fraud),

obl.noteInsurance: Even if Artisan‑Compétent performs these checks upstream, coverage can change over time for various reasons, or certain specific works may not be included in the policy.

items.cancelGuarantees: cancellation of all guarantees provided by the platform,
items.cmodImpossible: impossibility for CMOD to intervene in case of dispute.

pv.title: Project validation
pv.text: The final acceptance report is mandatory to release funds. Without formal validation of this document, no payment can be made.

q7.goal: These rules have a simple goal: protect you, prevent abuses and ensure a secure, transparent and smooth experience for all parties.

q8.title: What is an CMOD?

items.indep: Independent construction professional, no link to the site provider.
items.role1: Helps you with technical understanding and quote analysis.
items.role2: Intervenes in case of doubt, misunderstanding or dispute.

q8.note: The CMOD is not a site manager and does not intervene physically. It's a guarantee of safety and neutrality.
